title: World Cleanup Day Impact and Sustainable Asia Conference 2024
author: Thanh Mai Tran
summary: World Cleanup Day Impact and Sustainable Asia Conference 2024

contentBlocks.value: Last week, I had the opportunity to participate in the World Cleanup Day Impact & Sustainable Asia Conference 2024 held in Penang, Malaysia, on the behalf of Let’s Do It! Hanoi.

The conference focused on empowering leaders from various countries within the global network, enhancing leadership skills, sharing best practices in green initiatives, and fostering a robust network of like-minded individuals.

The gathering united country leaders, governmental representatives, and stakeholders supporting Let’s Do It World Network in Asia. It focused on success stories, waste management practices, and establishing a collaborative network for the World Cleanup Day campaign in Asia

During the conference, I engaged with leaders from various countries including Malaysia, Indonesia, Cambodia, Thailand, Japan, Myanmar, Taiwan, Singapore, Kenya, and Pakistan, Let’s Do It World Official, World Cleanup Day Official. Furthermore, I had the privilege of learning about remarkable initiatives from organizations such as JCI United Penang, JCI Thailand, JCI Malaysia, Bikkuri Marks, Malaysian Humanitarian Foundation, and Monash University Malaysia.
